items.question: Which mantra components are appended to complete the stated sequence?
premises: The own-seed-triad is named as a component.
The syllables kūrca and lajjā are specified.
The same prior elements and fire-beloved are repeated.
items.inference: The sequence is completed by adding the own-seed-triad, kūrca, lajjā, and then repeating those same elements together with fire-beloved.
uncertainties: The exact referents of nija+bīja+trayaṃ and tāni+eva depend on the immediately preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Add the own-seed-triad, kūrca, and lajjā, then again those very same elements followed by fire-beloved.
